notes: Rules in code: perf/launch.py:9 and judge() 89-99 (exit 1 through finish(), line 62-71: 'return 1 if bad or nj or not verdicts else 0'); the four verdict rows are 'warm, fresh copy' judged against LAUNCH_COLD_MS 1500 (a new copy's first launch, launch-r3 ruling in the judge() comment, lines 91-94), 'warm, same copy' against LAUNCH_SAME_COPY_MS 400 (docs/CONSTANTS.md:12; this is the acceptance's 'warm launch to inbox >= 400 ms'), 'cold launch' against LAUNCH_COLD_MS 1500 and 'first frame' against FIRST_FRAME_MS 100 (CONSTANTS.md:9-11). Selftest cases at perf/launch.py:142-167 print 'ok|BAD <case> over=[...]' per case: 'cold at budget' (cold flips at 1500), 'first frame at budget', 'same copy at budget (its own row)', 'fresh copy at the cold budget'; so each of the three thresholds has a selftest line that goes BAD on a one-character mutant (the 'launch threshold mutant' the reader found missing: these 4). perf/interaction.py: judge() 79-92 (commit < INTERACTION_COMMIT_MS 50; arrival to first frame < 50+16; longest presented-frame gap < 1.5 x FRAME_MS = 24), selftest 106-127; 'a perfect 60 Hz gap is fine' and 'a dropped frame (33 ms gap)' are in it. NOTE the acceptance says 'any frame >= 16 ms'; the code, by the lead's ruling of 2026-11-09 (CONSTANTS.md:13, interaction.py:2-5), judges the longest presented-frame gap under 24 ms and the arrival-to-first-frame under 66 ms: the acceptance text and the ledger disagree, the code follows the ledger; the owner may want the sentence changed. perf/memory-mac.py: judge() 126-132 (>= MEM_MAC_MB 600, CONSTANTS.md:16; only counts at accounts == 30), selftest 135-171 including 'at budget', 'a plausible figure over the budget fails'. The selftests need no app. Proof 3 is the lead's: perf gates give no verdict above PERF_LOAD_MAX (perf/launch.py:55-58), so they need a quiet machine; the 30-account fixture is `fixture load full-history-30`, 300,000 messages (memory-mac.py:20-22). The mutants are in the python of the gate itself, which is the thing the item delivers; the mutant touches no app and needs no build.
